messages:
Mia Chen: Quick pulse on Northstar — noticed p95 jumped to ~320ms and p99 hit ~1.8s yesterday on /chat with model-r2. Streaming calls looked stable but sync (non-stream) tail spiked. Filing a short ops note before Monday renewal sync.
Samir Patel: Investigating now. Quick numbers snapshot from 2024-03-12: /chat model-r2 streaming p95=210ms p99=760ms, sync p95=320ms p99=1800ms. /embed model-e1 streaming p95=120ms p99=240ms, sync p95=450ms p99=980ms. Overall errors rose 0.12% -> 0.45% between 14:00-15:30 UTC.
Olivia Ruiz: Ugh — did spend jump too? If cost + latency both higher that makes renewal convo trickier.
Samir Patel: Yes, token consumption doubled for a short window (bursting inference jobs) — estimated daily spend +28% vs baseline. Error spike correlated with the same burst.
Harry Ng: Onboarding note: they still haven't finished prompt tuning session we proposed. Could reduce sync load if we push streaming-first patterns. Also we left KV-cache TTL conservative; can tighten to reduce re-compute.
CS Bot: ALERT: Northstar - latency tail breached SLA (p99 > 1500ms) at 2024-03-12T14:07Z. Incident INC-20240312-57 created.
Samir Patel: Trace snippet from host gpu-12 for the spike:
```
route=/embed model=model-e1 mode=sync p99=980ms errors=0.7% host=gpu-12
```
Mia Chen: Proposed immediate actions: 1) enable streaming fallback on /embed for 24h, 2) run a quantized canary for model-r2 on a small cohort, 3) schedule enablement + renewal pre-brief with Northstar. Thoughts?
Olivia Ruiz: +1 to streaming fallback, I'll book a 30m call Thu 10am PT and include the renewal owner. I'll surface the spend delta and tail numbers.
Harry Ng: I'll open the canary rollout for quantized model-r2 and raise autoscale headroom by +30% for 48h to absorb bursts.
Samir Patel: Set up a regression alert and dashboard tile: <https://redwood.app/dashboards/abc123|Northstar-tailboard>. Added check: p99>1s by route+model -> page.
Mia Chen: Great. Action owners: Samir (telemetry/alerts), Harry (canary & autoscale), Olivia (customer comms). We'll reconvene Fri EOD for status. :thumbsup:
